blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY— A portion of the P512-million concrete bridge under construction in Gandara, Samar, collapsed on Tuesday after two girders gave way during the removal of a roller attachment. No workers were injured in the incident, according to the project contractor. After the collapse, President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. directed the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) to respond immediately and ensure all personnel were safe.
